---
title: "Python workshops"
---

Two workshops:

1. [Python Introduction](intro.qmd): functions, objects, lists and dictionaries, indexing, iterating, importing packages, through an example of analysing text. For people with little or no Python.
2. Python Web Scraping: requests, JSON, XPath, and parsing HTML. Intermediate. *Being converted; its examples depend on a website that has changed since 2021.*

Before either, follow the [installation page](install.qmd). Each workshop's page links to its materials (data, a cheat sheet, a BLANK notebook to type along in, and the exercise solutions).
